reason: 停滞的是缩小差距这个过程，不是差距本身；“差距的停滞”搭配不当，属于名词化的译文腔。改后意思准确，也是地道的标题说法（正文第6至8句给出了原因，标题用“为何”切题）。
why: The problem is real: 差距的停滞 is a poor collocation, since what stalled is the closing of the gap, not the gap itself. But the proposal overclaims. 为何让 states as fact that the policies caused the stall, while the passage only reports the study's claim (perhaps; it's possible ... either way). 不再缩小 is also inaccurate, because convergence fell to 0.03 points a year, not zero. The amended title echoes sentence 19 (the journey towards wage parity ... stalled) and avoids both problems.

指出的问题成立：停滞的是缩小差距的进程，“差距的停滞”搭配不当。但改成“为何让”就把因果关系说成了定论，而文中只说研究认为“可以归因于”（perhaps counterintuitively），第19句作者还提出无论有无该政策都可能停滞。另外 0.03 个百分点也不等于“不再缩小”。改为“平等进程的停滞”，搭配正确，对应原文 stagnation 和 process towards salary equity，也不夸大因果。
orig_proposed: 家庭假政策为何让性别工资差距不再缩小

current: had sth done
proposed: had + subject + done
reason: In dictionaries, "had sth done" is the causative pattern (have sth done, 让某事被做), as in "I had my hair cut". Here the pattern is the if-less inverted conditional (Had that trend continued = If that trend had continued), so a learner seeing "had sth done" will confuse the two. The headword should show the inversion: had + subject + past participle.
why: The current text matches. Dictionaries list had sth done as the causative pattern (have sth done), which learners will confuse with this if-less inverted conditional. had + subject + done makes the inversion pattern explicit, and the existing gloss already explains it.
